name: Boar, Pit
body:
No larger than a small dog, this creature gives a loud, ear-splitting squeal when threatened, and its pointed tusks can be quite dangerous.

Pit Boar
CR 1

XP 400
N Small animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+2 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +1
Defensive Abilities ferocity

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee gore +3 (1d6+1)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 14, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 3
Base Atk +2; CMB +1; CMD 13
Feats Toughness
Skills Perception +6

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or tropical forests
Organization solitary, pair, or group (3–8)
Treasure none

No larger than a small dog, this species of boar is adapted to living in the warm, wet environment of the jungle and the veldts along its fringes. Easily able to hide in the underbrush because of its small size, the creature gives a loud, ear-splitting squeal when threatened, and its pointed tusks can be quite dangerous. Jungle natives who live near their habitat believe the boars to be watchers over the souls of those who have died within the jungle. As such, they eat boar meat only after giving thanks to the deceased animal’s spirit, and they prefer to consume it as infrequently as possible.
